title: Refactor duplicated validation logic in Go
description: Two handlers (CreateUser, UpdateUser) each duplicate the same email+name validation logic inline. Extract it into a validateUser helper and call it from both. All tests must remain green.

task_spec.prompt: Refactor handlers.go to eliminate the duplicated validation logic. Extract a private validateUser(u User) error function that checks name and email are non-empty, and call it at the start of both CreateUser and UpdateUser. The behavior of both functions must be unchanged — all 6 tests must remain green.
success_criteria: Validation logic appears only once (in validateUser helper)
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `go test ./...` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
